claims.statement: Issue-field feature resolves FPT/GHEC and GHES>=3.23. Setting/editing values requires repository triage or greater; organization definition management authority is separate.

Fields apply to issues, not pull requests. Select/text/number/date values save automatically; URL detection is presentation. Clearing removes an unpinned value from the sidebar and permits re-adding, not deletion of organization definition.

Fields pinned by issue type appear automatically on creation/view. Current source excludes URL-prefill and issue-template assignment; sidebar, Projects, API and Actions are documented alternatives rather than implemented bindings.

Timeline records field/new value/actor/time; organization-only events are hidden from outsiders. Public field visibility does not grant underlying private issue access; repository accessibility remains necessary.
Search examples use field.priority:high, comma OR values and quoted target-date comparisons. These field-qualified selectors are distinct from unqualified labels or Projects custom-field state.

REST/GraphQL management and value interfaces are named; actual endpoints, schema, permissions, pagination and mutation verification require adapter review. Actions issues field_added covers set/update and field_removed clearing; payload describes prior/new values without transactional recovery guarantee.

Organization owners manage shared field definitions across repositories; feature scope FPT/GHEC/GHES>=3.23. Limits are 25 organization fields, 100 single-select options, 10 pinned per type and 50 total Projects fields including system/issue fields.

Enablement creates Priority Urgent/High/Medium/Low, Effort High/Medium/Low and Start/Target dates. Priority pins to no-type/Bug/Task/Feature; Effort Bug/Task/Feature; both dates Feature only. Configurable defaults are not universal adopted policy or assigned default values.

Creation supplies name, optional description, type/options and visibility/pinning; edit uses explicit save. Pin order is per type; unpinned/no-value fields hide, Add field/Projects can expose them. The note requiring pinning versus value-based sidebar display needs contextual handling.
Deleting a definition permanently removes all issue values for that field. Recreating a field is not data restoration; approved export/recovery design required before any actual destructive change.

Organization-only is default for new/existing fields and limits visibility to members/read collaborators across UI/API/timeline/search. Public permission setting applies to public-repository issues, not disclosure authority for private issues.

Public and internal Projects display only Public fields; switching Public to Organization-only automatically removes the field from public Projects. Restoring visibility is described but prior view configuration restoration is not guaranteed.

Issue fields hold shared issue-level truth across Projects; custom Project fields remain local and can coexist/confuse. Migration instruction creates equivalent issue field then removes Project field from views, but does not specify copying existing values or validating successful migration.
Type management declares FPT/GHEC/GHES wildcard, organization owner authority, 25-type variable limit and editable/disablable/deletable Task/Bug/Feature defaults.
Types classify issues and support list/search/Projects filters; creation supplies name/description/color. Display classification is not independent acceptance or enforcement.

Disabling hides a type and prevents new assignment while re-enable restores display on previously typed issues. Deletion permanently removes the type; this distinct lifecycle must not be generalized as identical reversible disable/delete behavior.
